records.claim: If a person who is breastfeeding has a yeast infection of the breast, the infant might also have oral thrush (a yeast infection in the mouth). If the child does have oral thrush, they will need their own medical treatment because the amount of fluconazole that passes into the breast milk is not enough to treat the child’s infection. If you suspect the baby has oral thrush or other symptoms, contact the child’s healthcare provider. Be sure to talk to your healthcare provider about all your breastfeeding questions.
